question: Which of the following states receives rainfall during the winter season?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tamil Nadu** receives rainfall during the winter season.
 
• This is due to the phenomenon known as the **Northeast Monsoon**, which occurs from October to December.
 
• The Northeast Monsoon winds pick up moisture from the Bay of Bengal and bring rainfall to the southeas
